Repair Controller. start() issues an increasing generation, sets busy=True, preserves rows and decisions. poll_status(generation,status) returns whether caller should fetch full results: only the latest running generation transitioning to completed returns True ONCE. queued/running keep busy, failed ends busy without fetching. Stale/duplicate statuses return False. finish(generation,rows) accepts only latest completed pending results once, copies rows, ends busy; stale/unrequested finish returns False. set_decision(job_id,value) persists independent of all refreshes. No network calls.
